title: Select the optimal nonlinear compatible mixed-model stress at natural rough regularity
statement: For fixed actual x/y, H>=0 inL2,s inL4/3,F_H(u)=u^THu/12+g|u|4, minimize integral[F_H(Dpsi)+s.Dpsi] over periodic W1,4 scalar psi of mean0. Quartic coercivity/strict convexity and bounded map L4->L2:u->H^1/2u give unique minimizer u*=Dpsi*. Euler stress tau*=s+Hu*/6+4g|u*|²u* is solenoidal with its mean retained. Optimal defect D(H,s)=min_divtau0 integral F_H^*(s-tau)=-min_psi integral[F_H(Dpsi)+s.Dpsi]=integral[u*^THu*/12+3g|u*|4]. Fenchel equality at -u* and solenoidal pairing fix the signs. For any actual trial u=Dpsi, r=P_grad(s+Hu/6+4g|u|²u), L(u)=-integral[F_H(u)+s.u], max(0,L)<=D<=L+C_(g/3)integral|r|4/3. Rational finite Fourier trials give exact Laurent L and certified natural-moment bounds; no pointwise conjugate optimizer/positive eigenvalue floor required. This optimizes a LOWER model, not the whole original problem.
